body.name: \(P_{\mathsf Q,\pi^\dagger}\)
body.construction: For each \(\mathsf Q\in\mathcal Q_8\), integrate the fixed-before-assignment latent variables in \(\mathsf Q\) to obtain the conditional observed-outcome density \(q_{\mathsf Q}(y\mid w)\), and define \(P_{\mathsf Q,\pi^\dagger}(w,y)=g_{\pi^\dagger}(w,y)q_{\mathsf Q}(y\mid w)\).
